title: RENDER: Controlling Reader-Facing Evidence in LLM Memory Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23568v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory and RAG evaluations often treat the answering model's input as an implementation detail, even though systems may render the same history as a memory entry, summary, typed record, or raw excerpt. We introduce RENDER, a benchmark control that fixes the conversation while varying the reader-facing artifact. RENDER combines a five-level packet ladder, localizing when answer-bearing content enters the input, with deterministic templates approximating ChatGPT-style entries, LangChain summaries, MemGPT-style typed records, and raw conversation. On 500 LongMemEval questions and nine models, matched-budget resolved packets beat recency-truncated raw dialogue by 42.4-72.6 points. In deployed-style templates, best-worst spread is 24.6-48.8 points per model; under the primary scorer, ChatGPT-style entries have higher point estimates than raw conversation on 7 of 9 models. translated_title: RENDER：控制大语言模型记忆评估中的读者可见证据
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23568v1 公告类型：新 摘要：记忆和RAG评估通常将回答模型的输入视为实现细节，即使系统可能将相同的历史记录呈现为记忆条目、摘要、类型化记录或原始摘录。我们引入了RENDER，一个基准控制方法，它固定对话内容，同时改变读者可见的呈现形式。RENDER结合了一个五级数据包阶梯，定位答案承载内容进入输入的时间点，以及模拟ChatGPT风格条目、LangChain摘要、MemGPT风格类型化记录和原始对话的确定性模板。在500个LongMemEval问题和九个模型上，匹配预算的解析数据包比仅截断最近内容的原始对话提高了42.4-72.6分。在部署风格的模板中，每个模型的最佳与最差差异为24.6-48.8分；在主要评分器下，ChatGPT风格条目在9个模型中的7个上比原始对话具有更高的点估计值。法官重新评分保持了正向的总体效应，但模型特定差异仍然存在。
tldr: 该论文提出RENDER基准，通过控制读者可见的呈现形式，证明在LLM记忆评估中，数据包解析和模板设计能显著提升回答质量，优于原始对话截断。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces RENDER benchmark, showing that controlling reader-facing artifacts via packet parsing and templates significantly improves LLM memory evaluation performance over raw dialogue truncation.
